HII is the sharpest expression because it is the sole builder of US nuclear aircraft carriers, so carrier force-generation demand reads straight into its book, and because its fundamentals never participated in the de-rating: Q2 revenue $3.4B +10.9%, diluted EPS $5.27 against a $3.84 estimate, backlog $57.3B, and management raised FY26 shipbuilding revenue guidance to $10.2-10.4B from $9.7-9.9B while lifting the low end of the margin range to 6.0-6.5%.
